key_insight: FLICD adaptively learns cost-function frequencies during optimization, reducing reliance on preset frequency sets for parameterized quantum circuits.
engineering_relevance: Online frequency learning offers a path to scaling structure-aware circuit optimization while reducing quantum resource use relative to ICD in simulator tests.
method: Update circuit parameters using interpolation-based coordinate descent.
Learn relevant cost-function frequencies online instead of fixing them in advance.
Use learned frequencies to construct cost-function approximations for parameter updates.
evidence_signal: Simulator tests report higher accuracy than COBYLA and lower quantum resource use than ICD; IBM hardware experiments reach 100 qubits and show robust performance as circuit layers increase.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify resource savings or establish whether the simulator advantages over baselines persist on noisy hardware.
paper_title: A Frequency-Learning Interpolation-Based Coordinate Descent Method to Optimize Parameterized Quantum Circuits on Quantum Hardware
